headline.text: L1 Sollich 4 folding fingers and cutter damaged — line stopped at 07:10, maintenance working but no restart by window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel across three Sollich lines with minor hiccups. Sollich 3 had a quick cleanup for chocolate buildup on the nut chute at 12:04, back running inside 20 minutes. Sollich 4 stopped at 07:10 when all folding fingers and the cutter were found bent — maintenance is on it but the line was still down at window close. Sollich 2 started the day with a mystery LOTO lock that had to be cut at 06:24 to get going.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 cleared several short stops across moulding and FFS. ML2 had leakers on bar bottoms at 09:09 that disappeared after a vibration adjustment. FFS took a few hits — a machine jam at 17:25, a blade alignment fix at 04:53, and a seal bar tape swap at 05:29, all cleared quickly. The line ran out of 5oz film at 02:04 and used the downtime to changeover to 3oz, back online at 06:12. One open issue: expiration date misprints from yesterday still need rework or hold.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 had a tough day on the truffle line. M4 belt tracking issues from yesterday escalated — the belt was damaged enough that maintenance cut it at 04:36 and it's not back yet. Separately, 3rd shift left the oil pump running overnight and flooded the chocolate system; QA and production spent 01:27 to 07:09 draining, restarting, and running capture tests to recover temper. ML4 couldn't install PTL2 yesterday because a gasket is missing, still no spare. WiFi went down at 01:58 with no update. ML1 ran clean.

notes.text: FFS overproduced by 2,526 cases due to a countdown tracker copy error from yesterday morning.
Shawn Jewkes reminded teams that M4 tracking faults were being reset without escalation, leading to belt damage — standard is to escalate, not just clear alarms.

resolved.title: LOTO lock on Cavanna 4 vacuum with missing key
resolved.summary: A lockout-tagout lock was found on the vacuum with no key available; operator searched cabinets and toolboxes.
resolved.resolution: Resolved at 06:24 — device removal form completed, lock cut, line started (Joseph Scott).

resolved.title: Chocolate buildup on nut chute before enrober
resolved.summary: Buildup on the chute was causing issues; team paused to clean and evaluate spacing between enrober and belt.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:18 — "The chute was cleaned up, and the spacing looks good" (S3 Enrober).

resolved.title: FFS machine cone filled with product
resolved.summary: The FFS cone filled and machine faulted, requiring a maintenance reset; problem started at 16:56.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 17:25 — "The machine is ready. We running again" (VFFS).

resolved.title: Leakers on bar bottoms out of spec
resolved.summary: Leakers appearing on the bottom of caramel bars despite dimensions being in range; vibration adjustment attempted.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 10:19 — "The leaks at the bottom of the bar have disappeared" after lowering vibration to both horizontal shakers (Claudio Tovar).

resolved.title: Film jam at flow-wrapper after CIL
resolved.summary: Line came up from CIL cleaning but jammed immediately at the flow-wrapper.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:22 — "Minor jam is clear and the line is running" (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: FFS cutting blade angled, causing corner defects
resolved.summary: QA flagged corner defects on pouches; maintenance found the cutting blade was offset and angled.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 22:53 — blade straightened and tightened, "Line is back up" (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: FFS ran out of 5oz film, changeover to 3oz
resolved.summary: Last roll of 5oz film ran out at 02:04; team used downtime to changeover from 5oz to 3oz format.
resolved.resolution: Completed at 06:12 — "successfully completed the switch from 5 oz to 3 oz" (Claudio Tovar).

resolved.title: Seal bar tape replacement needed
resolved.summary: Line stopped so maintenance could replace the tape on the FFS seal bar.

resolved.title: Truffle line guillotine blade and ultrasonic cutter faults
resolved.summary: Cutter blade broke down, reset 5 times; ultrasonic not working; traced to wrong recipe being saved over the correct one.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 23:12 — "Spencer saved over the recipe... You can now hear the sonic blade working. Team needs to do a reheat then they will start up" (Tyson Fausett).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 4 folding fingers and cutter bent, line down
needs_attention.summary: All folding fingers are bent and the cutter is damaged; maintenance working to realign and repair, line is stopped.
needs_attention.status: Line stopped at 07:10, maintenance on-site; no restart posted by window close at 07:15.

needs_attention.title: High candy rejection rate at Sollich 4 end-of-line
needs_attention.summary: Seeing elevated rejections despite weight and dimensions being in spec; supervisor and operators troubleshooting root cause.
needs_attention.status: Raised at 22:03; no update or resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: FFS expiration date misprints with extra digit
needs_attention.summary: Pouches printed with an extra digit on expiration date (20279 vs 20278); attempting rework or will hold affected pallets.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 07:36 yesterday; plan to rework or hold, no final disposition posted.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line M4 belt tracking damage, belt cut
needs_attention.summary: M4 belt tracked north over multiple shifts with repeated alarms being cleared instead of escalated; belt damaged, maintenance cut and replacing.
needs_attention.status: Belt damaged by 09:24 yesterday, cut by maintenance at 04:36; no restart posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line chocolate contaminated with excess oil
needs_attention.summary: 2nd shift left oil pump running while chocolate tank emptied; sent surplus oil into system, chocolate off-spec and oily to touch.
needs_attention.status: Draining tunnel and buffer tank since 02:06, still draining at 06:00, doing capture test at 07:09 to verify temper recovery.

needs_attention.title: Missing gasket for ML4 PTL2 installation
needs_attention.summary: One gasket is missing to complete PTL2 install; maintenance has no spares, team asked to check other buildings.
needs_attention.status: Raised at 07:50 yesterday; no spare found, PTL2 cannot be installed as of window close.

needs_attention.title: WiFi down in building
needs_attention.status: Down as of 01:58; no update posted.
